inputs.text: The DHS is absolutely right to call out ICE for finally arresting this immigrant gang member after New York City let him walk despite the obvious threat he posed to public safety. This case lays bare why sanctuary policies are nothing short of a reckless betrayal of law and order. Releasing criminals with records like his only invites more danger into our neighborhoods, and the local officials shielding them are openly defying federal authority to put outsiders ahead of American citizens. The real damage comes from these progressive cities fighting enforcement at every turn, which weakens our national sovereignty and the social stability essential for protecting families and preserving our traditional way of life. Strong federal action is the only way to restore real accountability and end this pattern of politics trumping the safety of our communities.
